coverage.method: Current source review against all 34 parts and all 11 Part 21 strategy families, plus AST parameter-use inventory. Original findings preserved separately in the baseline audit. Feature availability is not proof of learned strategy behavior or economic value.

strategies.assessment: MA ratios, slopes and trend strength exist; no standalone MA trend strategy or live trend rule.
SMA fast=5/slow=20 features; no explicit crossover entry/exit baseline; EMA not implemented.
Returns at 1/5/10/20/30 ticks and a ret_5 > 0 long/flat baseline. Live ML can consume features; directional behavior and added value unverified.

20-tick z-score, z-score change, reversal return; backtest long below -1.5/short above +1.5. Shared targets and spot exits implemented; paper/live short adapters use separate collateral accounting. Shorts remain disabled pending permission.
20-tick simple rolling RSI feature, including gains-only/losses-only/flat edge cases; no dedicated 30/70 strategy rule.
20-tick, 2-standard-deviation band position; no dedicated band entry/exit rule.
No prior-range highs/lows, channel break or breakout entry/exit baseline.
Realized volatility exists as context/sizing input; no return-versus-volatility breakout trigger.
Raw ticker trade-value fields retained, but no relative-volume, volume-change, volume-z-score or confirmation strategy. Raw fields reaching ML is not a defined volume strategy.

5-tick ranks/percentiles and relative returns; baseline thresholds 0.7/0.3. Bounded quote age and within-group ranking added; empirical basket diversification and market-neutral performance remain unverified.

Averaged momentum/z-score baseline and classifier feature combination exist. Purged temporal calibration and paired component comparisons added; historical contribution and portfolio P&L diversification remain untested.

handbook_sections.title: PART 1 — WHAT ALGORITHMIC TRADING ACTUALLY IS
handbook_sections.assessment: Shared signal-to-target rules and cash/quantity order deltas added; historical hypothesis evidence remains missing.

handbook_sections.title: PART 2 — BASIC MARKET AND CRYPTO TRADING CONCEPTS
handbook_sections.assessment: Spot and collateral-based short API conventions checked against official documentation; account permissions and spot fees still require verification.

handbook_sections.title: PART 3 — PRICE DATA AND MARKET DATA
handbook_sections.assessment: Exact duplicates removed, conflicts rejected, writes atomic, stale quotes/history gaps rejected and groups separated. Sampling cadence/outlier policy remains a research input.

handbook_sections.title: PART 4 — STATISTICS EVERY ALGORITHMIC TRADER SHOULD KNOW
handbook_sections.assessment: Signed training-only conditional payoffs replace probability-as-return. Broader statistical uncertainty and trade-level research remain missing.

handbook_sections.title: PART 5 — PROBABILITY AND STATISTICAL THINKING
handbook_sections.assessment: No uncertainty intervals, trial accounting or multiple-testing safeguards.

handbook_sections.title: PART 6 — TIME SERIES BASICS
handbook_sections.assessment: Rolling returns and volatility exist; no stationarity or autocorrelation research.

handbook_sections.title: PART 7 — FEATURES AND INDICATORS
handbook_sections.assessment: Returns/SMA/z-score/RSI/Bollinger/ranks/volatility implemented; no EMA, ATR, MACD, stochastic, VWAP or derived volume features.

handbook_sections.title: PART 8 — SIGNAL GENERATION
handbook_sections.assessment: Shared rule and model target interfaces with long/flat exits and optional signed targets; three rule families, not every handbook example.

handbook_sections.title: PART 9 — POSITION SIZING
handbook_sections.assessment: Finite confidence/volatility sizing, per-asset/gross caps, cash reserves and rounded quantity conversion tested with synthetic fixtures.

handbook_sections.title: PART 10 — LONG/SHORT STRATEGIES
handbook_sections.assessment: Spot sells reduce holdings; separate collateral-based paper/live short adapters support opening/closing. Shorts disabled by default; actual account behavior untested.

handbook_sections.title: PART 11 — BACKTESTING
handbook_sections.assessment: Sequential delayed-fill ledger, explicit terminal liquidation and initial-equity peaks; multi-asset runner accounting tested. Real venue parity unverified.

handbook_sections.title: PART 12 — HOW TO ACCIDENTALLY FAKE A PROFITABLE STRATEGY
handbook_sections.assessment: Unknown labels masked; actual label-availability times checked at purged boundaries. Feature builders pass future-shock prefix invariance; arbitrary feature provenance cannot be inferred from values.

handbook_sections.title: PART 13 — TRAINING / VALIDATION / TESTING
handbook_sections.assessment: Purged rolling validation and internal chronological probability calibration added. Final historical holdout not yet frozen or evaluated.

handbook_sections.title: PART 14 — OVERFITTING
handbook_sections.assessment: Training/validation scores recorded; no parameter stability or held-out evidence.

handbook_sections.title: PART 15 — ROBUSTNESS TESTING
handbook_sections.assessment: Offline failure fixtures cover stale quotes, gaps, duplicates, repeated orders, drawdown/rate limits, partial fills and uncertain responses. Historical parameter/cost/period stress grid not run.

handbook_sections.title: PART 16 — PERFORMANCE METRICS
handbook_sections.assessment: Terminal fees and initial-equity drawdown fixed; finite RMS-downside convention and explicit undefined annualization handling. Closed-trade expectancy/profit factor and organizer metric parity remain pending.

handbook_sections.title: PART 17 — TRANSACTION COSTS AND EXECUTION
handbook_sections.assessment: Training-only expected-return gate, live spread allowance and paper bid/ask/slippage/fees. Maker resting-fill model explicitly unsupported; measured venue costs not available.

handbook_sections.title: PART 18 — MARKET MICROSTRUCTURE
handbook_sections.assessment: Bid/ask used for paper fills and runner spread gate; depth, impact and actual execution calibration remain unverified.

handbook_sections.title: PART 19 — RISK MANAGEMENT
handbook_sections.assessment: Per-asset/gross caps, drawdown halt, persisted hourly reservations and shared request budget integrated and tested. Daily loss and correlated concentration policies remain research choices.

handbook_sections.title: PART 20 — PORTFOLIO CONSTRUCTION
handbook_sections.assessment: Signed gross exposure helper and runner portfolio sizing integrated; correlated cluster limits and empirical multi-asset diversification not established.

handbook_sections.title: PART 21 — STRATEGY IDEAS FOR A BEGINNER
handbook_sections.assessment: Three shared explicit rule families plus model feature combination. Missing breakout/volume examples remain optional research, not silently claimed coverage.

handbook_sections.title: PART 22 — COMBINING STRATEGIES
handbook_sections.assessment: Same-model/common-OOS regime/cost/sizing comparisons added; component switches respected. Empirical diversification and economic contribution still untested.

handbook_sections.title: PART 23 — MACHINE LEARNING
handbook_sections.assessment: Training-only scaler, purged temporal probability calibration, conditional payoffs, fixed schema, regression support and source/config model artifacts. Real prediction stability and held-out economic value remain untested.

handbook_sections.title: PART 24 — REINFORCEMENT LEARNING
handbook_sections.assessment: Reinforcement learning absent; handbook describes it as generally unnecessary for this beginner setting.

handbook_sections.title: PART 25 — BOT ARCHITECTURE
handbook_sections.assessment: Editable packaging fixes module startup. Explicit model loading, stateful paper ledger, live reconciliation adapter, delta planning and pre-submission uncertainty persistence added; API behavior only mocked.

handbook_sections.title: PART 26 — LIVE TRADING VS BACKTESTING
handbook_sections.assessment: Public/signed transport, shared rate budget, no mutation retries and fail-closed partial/pending/unknown states tested. Real partial fills, outages and recovery require paper/sandbox evidence.

handbook_sections.title: PART 27 — PAPER TRADING / DRY RUN
handbook_sections.assessment: Paper cash, quantities, collateral, bid/ask/slippage fills, fees and persisted restart state implemented; sustained online paper run not yet performed.

handbook_sections.title: PART 28 — LOGGING AND DEBUGGING
handbook_sections.assessment: Structured confirmed-fill events with quantity/price/fees/target/equity and persisted risk state. Production monitoring and venue slippage calibration remain future work.

handbook_sections.title: PART 29 — SOFTWARE ENGINEERING PRACTICES
handbook_sections.assessment: Editable package, configuration, seed, checksummed model/schema manifests and deterministic offline regression suite. Historical data/experiment manifests still needed.

handbook_sections.title: PART 30 — EXPERIMENTATION WORKFLOW
handbook_sections.assessment: Paired/common-OOS one-factor comparison scaffold repaired. Freeze data/parameters and record economic experiments before selection.

handbook_sections.title: PART 31 — HOW TO CONDUCT A GOOD TRADING EXPERIMENT
handbook_sections.assessment: No frozen hypothesis/data/config/cost records or rejected-experiment log.

handbook_sections.title: PART 32 — 20 THINGS THAT WILL PROBABLY GO WRONG IN YOUR FIRST TRADING BOT
handbook_sections.assessment: Original reproducible defects repaired and covered by regression fixtures. Remaining market/operational risks require evidence beyond fixtures.

handbook_sections.title: PART 33 — HACKATHON STRATEGY
handbook_sections.assessment: Team responsibilities, staged research and fallback operation are process choices; deployment instructions alone do not demonstrate readiness.

handbook_sections.title: PART 34 — FINAL CHEAT SHEET
handbook_sections.assessment: Some essential formulas implemented; final trust questions remain unresolved without out-of-sample/robustness and venue evidence.
